subject: Racial Disparities in Traffic Stop Outcomes
overview: The Council requested an investigation into racial disparities in traffic stop outcomes and passed a resolution supporting the Haitian community. They also approved a special permit for late-night business operations and discussed traffic mitigation in South Medford.

items.title: Casa Pizza Special Permit for Extended Hours
items.summary: Approved a special permit for Casa Pizza at 62 Lambert Street for extended hours until 2 a.m., with a 90-day review and a restriction to delivery-only service from Sunday through Thursday.

items.title: Community Garden Commission Appointment
items.summary: Approved the reappointment of Fred Lasky to the Community Garden Commission.

items.title: Condolences and Ceremonial Recognition
items.summary: Passed a resolution expressing condolences to the family of William F. Hopkins Jr. and observed a moment of silence.

items.title: South Medford Traffic Mitigation
items.summary: Referred a resolution investigating cut-through traffic, speed concerns, and street redesign in South Medford to the Subcommittee on Public Works and Utilities.

items.title: Police Traffic Stop Data and Racial Disparities
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting the Police Chief investigate potential causes for racial disparities in stop outcomes noted in a state report and publish comprehensive stop data on the city website.

items.title: Support for Haitian Migrants and Diaspora
items.summary: Passed a resolution supporting the local Haitian community and calling for an end to federal Title 42 deportations.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Accepted reports from the Committee of the Whole regarding an elections commission, senior tax deferrals, and paid family and medical leave implementation.

items.title: License Review Complaints and Minutes
items.summary: Requested a report from city departments regarding complaints on various active license reviews and approved the records of the previous meeting.
